sentences.en: Seeing him buff out my throw-ups wasn't a good feeling because creating that art took a lot out of me.

sentences.en: Like this one time, when I spent an entire night doing a piece with large bubble-style letters on a rooftop near Pico and Robertson,

sentences.en: And then this white guy named Joe would come out and erase us again.
sentences.zh: 然后这个叫乔的白人就会跑出来，把我们的痕迹再次抹去。

sentences.en: They call me the graffiti gorilla, among other things.

sentences.en: Look at that.
sentences.zh: 看看那个。

sentences.en: Isn't that beautiful?

sentences.en: And then you took a streak and then for some stupid reason, I was like, hey, let's record this.
sentences.zh: 然后你顺手拿了根马克笔，出于某种愚蠢的原因，我说，嘿，我们把这个拍下来吧。

sentences.en: And I took this video camera that I had.
sentences.zh: 于是我拿出了我带的这台摄像机。

sentences.en: We didn't make it to the store.
sentences.zh: 我们没走到商店。

sentences.en: We crossed the street and you decide to start tagging on a trash can.
sentences.zh: 我们刚过马路，你就决定开始在一个垃圾桶上涂鸦。

sentences.en: And my dumb ass, instead of looking out, looking back, I'm looking through the lens at you.
sentences.zh: 而我这个大笨蛋，没有去放风、没有回头看，而是透过镜头看着你。

sentences.en: And police pulled up on us.
sentences.zh: 然后警察的车就开到了我们跟前。

sentences.en: The cops handcuffed us, made us sit on the curb, and then separated us for questioning.
sentences.zh: 警察给我们戴上手铐，让我们坐在马路牙子上，然后把我们分开审问。

sentences.en: I was already on probation for a previous graffiti offense.
sentences.zh: 因为之前的涂鸦违规记录，我当时还在缓刑期。

sentences.en: I thought I was for sure going to juvie.
sentences.zh: 我以为自己这回绝对要进少管所了。

sentences.en: The cop says to me, what's your name?
sentences.zh: 警察对我说，你叫什么名字？

sentences.en: Back then, I hadn't started also using my mom's last name, Hernandez.
sentences.zh: 那时候，我还没开始用我妈妈的姓氏埃尔南德斯（Hernandez）。

sentences.en: So I said, Walter Thompson.
sentences.zh: 所以我说，沃尔特·汤普森（Walter Thompson）。

sentences.en: And the cops were like, that's not your name.
sentences.zh: 警察听了就说，这不是你的名字。

sentences.en: They thought I was lying to him.
sentences.zh: 他们以为我在对他们撒谎。

sentences.en: They thought Walter Thompson sounded like an 80-year-old white dude's name.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得沃尔特·汤普森听起来像个80岁白人老头的名字。

sentences.en: And now that I'm thinking about it, they were kind of right.
sentences.zh: 现在回想起来，他们还真没说错。

sentences.en: I remember them asking me about that.
sentences.zh: 我记得他们盘问过我这件事。

sentences.en: So what's your friend's name?
sentences.zh: 那么你朋友叫什么名字？

sentences.en: And I was like, Bezo.
sentences.zh: 我说，Bezo。

sentences.en: Because I'm not trying to give up your name.
sentences.zh: 因为我才不想把你的真名说出来。

sentences.en: I didn't know what you said.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你刚才报了什么名字。

sentences.en: So I was like, Bezo.
sentences.zh: 所以我胡扯了一个，Bezo。

sentences.en: And the cop was like, stop f***ing around.
sentences.zh: 警察就说，别他妈在这儿瞎胡闹。

sentences.en: I was like, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我说，我不知道。

sentences.en: I don't know his name.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他的名字。

sentences.en: Because I was like, maybe he's not going to give his name.
sentences.zh: 因为我在想，也许他不会报出自己的真名吧。

sentences.en: So Aloe and I started laughing at the cops for not believing me.
sentences.zh: 于是Aloe和我开始嘲笑警察不相信我。

sentences.en: But the cops, they didn't think it was funny.
sentences.zh: 但是警察可不觉得这有什么好笑的。

sentences.en: They got mad and they got frustrated.
sentences.zh: 他们被惹恼了，感到很挫败。

sentences.en: And put us in separate cars and took us back to the station.
sentences.zh: 然后把我们塞进不同的警车里，带回了警察局。

sentences.en: I went home after three hours.
sentences.zh: 三个小时后我就回家了。

sentences.en: But Aloe, he was there for almost three days.
sentences.zh: 但Aloe在那里呆了将近三天。

sentences.zh: 1976年的时候，我就睡在诺曼底这边带狗的车库里。

sentences.en: Because he couldn't let me stay in his house.
sentences.zh: 因为他不能让我留在屋里住。

sentences.en: But he was like, hey, I got a garage.
sentences.zh: 但他对我说，嘿，我有个车库。

sentences.en: And sometimes me and a dog would fight over who would sleep on the couch.
sentences.zh: 有时候我和那只狗还会为谁睡沙发而争抢。

sentences.en: That's where graffiti really kicked into high gear.
sentences.zh: 那就是涂鸦真正进入白热化阶段的时候。

sentences.en: Because I was out, depressed, lonely, hungry.
sentences.zh: 因为当时我无家可归、沮丧、孤独、饥饿。

sentences.en: And this is the only thing that kept my spirit to letting that trauma out during graffiti.
sentences.zh: 这是唯一能支撑我的精神、通过涂鸦将那些创伤宣泄出来的方式。

sentences.en: There's a human need to express yourself.
sentences.zh: 人类有一种表达自我的本能需求。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, the lower classes and the impoverished don't have the spaces and the walls to just be creative.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，下层阶级和穷人们没有空间和墙壁来单纯地进行创作。

sentences.en: I don't, I don't, it would take a lot.

sentences.zh: 噢天哪，看看这个。

sentences.en: This stuff is, this is stuff on top of stuff on top of stuff.
sentences.zh: 这东西，这都是一层压一层又一层的涂鸦。

sentences.en: A lot of people get, they don't get that graffiti has to start with all these tags
sentences.zh: 很多人不明白，他们不理解涂鸦必须从所有这些标签开始

sentences.en: and then it moves to a throw up and then it can be a mural and it can be a burner.
sentences.zh: 然后发展成草图，然后可以是一幅壁画，也可以是一个精细作品。

sentences.en: I mean, it's, it's, and a lot of them, their stories are interesting to hear.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这，这，而且他们当中很多人的故事听起来都很有趣。

sentences.en: Well, I kind of can read it.

sentences.zh: 她早上6点把我从警察局接了出来。

sentences.zh: 我又开始打篮球了。

sentences.en: So I'm getting cheery as I'm saying this right now.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在说这话时心情挺轻松的。

sentences.en: And I stopped smoking weed and drinking too.
sentences.zh: 我也戒掉了抽大麻和喝酒。

sentences.en: After that, I just, I think I couldn't find anyone else to really connect with.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，我只是，我想我找不到其他人能真正产生共鸣了。

sentences.en: And then I actually started getting more into like fighting for some reason.
sentences.zh: 然后我实际上不知为什么开始对打架更感兴趣了。

sentences.en: I was never like a big fighter.
sentences.zh: 我以前从来不是一个好勇斗狠的人。

sentences.en: But all of a sudden, I'm like Mr. Macho Man and I want to fight everybody.
sentences.zh: 但突然之间，我好像成了纯爷们儿，看谁都想打。

sentences.en: My best friend and I wouldn't see or talk to each other for 17 years.
sentences.zh: 我和我最好的朋友有17年没见面或说话了。

sentences.en: It was one of the hardest choices I ever made because I left friends behind who I considered family.
sentences.zh: 这是我做过的最艰难的选择之一，因为我抛下了那些我视为家人的朋友。

sentences.en: And it hit the hardest when I'd see their names on walls and not my own.
sentences.zh: 而最让人痛苦的是，当我看到墙上写着他们的名字却没有我自己的时候。

sentences.en: It felt like they carried on with their lives and forgot about me.
sentences.zh: 感觉他们继续过着自己的生活，却把我给忘了。

sentences.en: And it was harder because deep inside, I knew that it was something I brought upon myself.
sentences.zh: 更艰难的是，内心深处我知道这是我自找的。

sentences.en: I left the world where I was completely seen, only to reenter a world where being seen wasn't guaranteed.
sentences.zh: 我离开了那个完全被人看见的世界，却重新进入了一个无法保证能被人看见的世界。

sentences.en: And for a 14-year-old, it was all really confusing.
sentences.zh: 对于一个14岁的孩子来说，这一切真的很困惑。

sentences.en: I wanted to change.
sentences.zh: 我想改变。

sentences.en: And soon, the entire LA Graffiti world would also change.
sentences.zh: 不久，整个洛杉矶涂鸦界也将发生改变。

sentences.en: We return with more California love after this.
sentences.zh: 稍后我们将带回更多加州之恋。

sentences.en: By 2006, Sight had briefly stepped back from Graffiti.
sentences.zh: 到2006年时，赛特曾短暂退出过涂鸦界。

sentences.en: He was no longer homeless, but his mom was.
sentences.zh: 他不再无家可归了，但他妈妈还是。

sentences.en: He was working to save money to buy his mom a home because he wanted to rescue her from the park she was sleeping in.
sentences.zh: 他努力存钱想给妈妈买个房子，因为他想把她从她睡觉的公园里解救出来。

sentences.en: He was going to school at a community college and working two jobs.
sentences.zh: 他在一所社区大学上学，还打着两份工。

sentences.en: And my grandmother was like, after she saw how productive I was and how serious I was, she was like, look, why don't you just live here?
sentences.zh: 我外婆看到我多有成效、多严肃认真之后，就说，听着，你为什么不干脆住这儿呢？

sentences.en: About the time I walked away from Graffiti, what used to be a misdemeanor offense was now a felony.
sentences.zh: 就在我远离涂鸦的这段时间里，以前属于轻罪的行为现在成了重罪。

sentences.en: Graffiti artists started doing a hard time for their art.
sentences.zh: 涂鸦艺术家们开始因为他们的艺术而遭受牢狱之灾。

sentences.en: Some people in LA refer to this time as a terror campaign.
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶的一些人把这段时期称为恐怖运动。

sentences.en: It's when Taggart's homes were reportedly being raided like they were drug dealers or members of a violent gang.
sentences.zh: 据说当时涂鸦者的家遭到突击搜查，就像他们是毒贩或暴力帮派成员一样。

sentences.en: It was a perfect sunny day at South Central LA.
sentences.zh: 那是洛杉矶中南部一个完美而晴朗的日子。

sentences.en: As Ice Cube would say in a couple of days before Thanksgiving, 2006.
sentences.zh: 正如冰块酷伯在2006年感恩节前几天所说的那样。

sentences.en: You hear loud bangs on the door.
sentences.zh: 你听到门上有巨大的砸门声。

sentences.en: I'm in the bed naked, asleep.
sentences.zh: 我光着身子躺在床上睡觉。

sentences.en: My auntie go open the door, told her, don't open the door, I don't know who that is.
sentences.zh: 我阿姨去开门，我告诉她，别开门，我不知道那是谁。

sentences.en: She opened the door anyway.
sentences.zh: 她还是把门打开了。

sentences.en: The police come in looking like they're in war gear.
sentences.zh: 警察冲进来，看起来像是穿着作战装备。

sentences.en: There's like seven, eight of them.
sentences.zh: 大约有七八个吧。

sentences.en: On top of your head, put your hands on top of your head.
sentences.zh: 把手抱在头上，把手放在头上。

sentences.en: They got assault rifles with beams coming out of them.
sentences.zh: 他们拿着带激光瞄准器的突击步枪。

sentences.en: They pull me out into the main den.
sentences.zh: 他们把我拉到主起居室。

sentences.en: And they're like, where are the drugs and where are the guns?
sentences.zh: 他们质问，毒品在哪儿，枪在哪儿？

sentences.en: I'm like, there's no drugs and guns here.
sentences.zh: 我说，这里没有毒品和枪。

sentences.en: You got the wrong person.
sentences.zh: 你们抓错人了。

sentences.en: You got them raided at the wrong house.
sentences.zh: 你们搜查错房子了。

sentences.en: There is no drugs or guns.
sentences.zh: 根本没有什么毒品或枪支。

sentences.en: They're like, where is the guns and the drugs?
sentences.zh: 他们质问，枪和毒品在哪儿？

sentences.en: You want to check these?
sentences.zh: 你想检查这些吗？

sentences.en: Or do you think it's worth it?
sentences.zh: 还是你觉得这值得吗？

sentences.en: They're tearing up the whole house.
sentences.zh: 他们把整栋房子砸得稀巴烂。

sentences.en: They put some shoes on me, no socks, pants, no belt, shirt, handcuff me.
sentences.zh: 他们给我套上鞋子，没穿袜子，穿上裤子，没系皮带，套上衬衫，给我戴上手铐。

sentences.en: They walk me outside.
sentences.zh: 他们把我押到外面。

sentences.en: We got a whole neighborhood outside watching, you know, those people be.
sentences.zh: 外面有一整条街的邻居在围观，你知道那些人就是那样。

sentences.en: They took me down to the sheriff's station in Watts.
sentences.zh: 他们把我带到瓦茨的治安官局。

sentences.en: And they were high-fiving, man.
sentences.zh: 他们还在击掌庆祝呢，伙计。

sentences.en: They were high-fiving.
sentences.zh: 他们在击掌相庆。

sentences.en: They were like, yeah, we got this dude.
sentences.zh: 他们说，太棒了，我们抓到这家伙了。

sentences.en: We've been looking for this dude forever.
sentences.zh: 我们找这家伙找了半天了。

sentences.en: I'm like, wow.
sentences.zh: 我说，哇。

sentences.en: When I'm out through my head, I'm like, I didn't know graffiti was this serious.
sentences.zh: 我脑子里想的是，我不知道涂鸦这么严重。

sentences.en: If I knew graffiti was this serious, then I would have not have been messing with it.
sentences.zh: 如果我知道涂鸦这么严重，那我根本就不会去碰它了。

sentences.en: They gave me an interrogation room.
sentences.zh: 他们把我关进审讯室。

sentences.en: I don't know, no law.
sentences.zh: 我不懂什么法律。

sentences.en: Sent me down.
sentences.zh: 把我带下去。

sentences.en: They sit down a folder of paperwork about six inches tall.
sentences.zh: 他们放下厚厚一叠约六英寸高的文件档案。

sentences.en: All photos of stuff I did in L.A.
sentences.zh: 全都是我在洛杉矶搞的涂鸦照片。

sentences.en: And they opened a folder to show me pictures.
sentences.zh: 然后他们翻开文件夹给我看照片。

sentences.en: I'm like, dude, this is all, this stuff is all old, dude.
sentences.zh: 我说，老兄，这全都是，这些东西全都是老黄历了，老兄。

sentences.en: They were like, if you date these to a more recent date, we'll let you out today.
sentences.zh: 他们说，如果你把这些标上更近的日期，我们今天就放你出去。

sentences.en: I'm like, for real?
sentences.zh: 我说，真的假的？

sentences.en: It wasn't for real.
sentences.zh: 当然不是真的。

sentences.en: Sight was charged with multiple accounts of nonviolent felony vandalism.
sentences.zh: 赛特被指控多项非暴力重罪破坏财产罪。

sentences.en: He says the evidence he signed ended up being used against him in court.
sentences.zh: 他说他签署的证据最终在法庭上变成了对付他的武器。

sentences.en: According to him, they had him date pictures of his tags to a more recent time
sentences.zh: 据他所说，他们让他把涂鸦照片的日期标得更近一些

sentences.en: to land within the statute of limitations.
sentences.zh: 以便落入追诉时效之内。

sentences.en: Sight was facing around 30 years in prison, so he did what he had to do,
sentences.zh: 赛特面临大约30年的监禁，所以他只能妥协，

sentences.en: and he took a deal for eight years and eight months.
sentences.zh: 他接受了判处八年零八个月的认罪协议。

sentences.en: His sentencing was just part of the city's draconian anti-graffiti movement,
sentences.zh: 他的判决只是该市严厉的反涂鸦运动的一部分，

sentences.en: and multiple hometown heroes like him were arrested.
sentences.zh: 像他这样的多位本地英雄都被逮捕了。

sentences.en: City attorneys say it's about time taggers are treated like criminal gang members.
sentences.zh: 城市检察官表示，是时候把涂鸦者当成犯罪帮派成员来对待了。

sentences.en: In 09, then-L.A.
sentences.zh: 在09年，时任洛杉矶

sentences.en: city attorney Carmen Chuchanich had a mission to go after writers.
sentences.zh: 城市检察官卡门·丘恰尼奇有一个打击涂鸦者的任务。

sentences.en: He and his staff began to gather street-level intelligence
sentences.zh: 他和他的团队开始收集街头情报

sentences.en: and prepared injunctions targeting graffiti crews.
sentences.zh: 并准备针对涂鸦帮派发布禁令。

sentences.en: While Sight was in prison, a lot of taggers reached out to him to provide support,
sentences.zh: 在赛特入狱期间，许多涂鸦者联系他以示支持，

sentences.en: including one he didn't know that well, but who I used to be really tight with.
sentences.zh: 其中包括一个我不太熟，但我以前关系非常铁的人。

sentences.en: Aloe wrote me while I was in prison.
sentences.zh: 在我坐牢期间，阿洛给我写过信。

sentences.en: I met him only once in person on the Venice Bus.
sentences.zh: 我本人只在威尼斯公交车上见过他一次。

sentences.en: I never hung out with him like that.
sentences.zh: 我从来没有跟他怎么混在一起过。

sentences.en: He went to prison for something that we were all doing.
sentences.zh: 他因为我们所有人都在做的事情而进了监狱。

sentences.en: Like, that could have been any one of us, is what I'm saying.
sentences.zh: 我是说，那本来可能发生在我们任何一个人身上。

sentences.en: So it's like, you gotta pay respect to him.
sentences.zh: 所以这就好比，你必须尊重他。

sentences.en: For him to only meet me that once or twice and want to be like,
sentences.zh: 他只跟我见了一两面，就想要说，

sentences.en: hey, I'm going to reach out to this dude.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我要去联系这家伙。

sentences.en: All I can say is graffiti did that.
sentences.zh: 我只能说，是涂鸦促成了这一切。

sentences.en: We wrote together every, yeah, like every three weeks or so.
sentences.zh: 我们以前一起写，对，差不多每三周左右一次。

sentences.en: What am I doing?
sentences.zh: 我在干什么？

sentences.en: How's everything going?
sentences.zh: 一切都还好吧？

sentences.en: Just trying to see where his mind was at.
sentences.zh: 只是想看看他当时心里在想什么。

sentences.en: I felt good, man.
sentences.zh: 感觉挺好的，兄弟。

sentences.en: I felt like I wasn't alone.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我不是一个人。

sentences.en: I felt like graffiti is bigger than what, it's more than what people think it is.
sentences.zh: 我觉得涂鸦的意义比人们想象的要宏大得多，远不止他们以为的那样。

sentences.en: I was in there for about five years, because I was like, good behavior, fire camp, all that stuff.
sentences.zh: 我在里面呆了大约五年，因为表现好、去了消防营之类的事情。

sentences.en: And then he was like, you know, like a year or two before I got out, he was like,
sentences.zh: 然后他就在我出狱前的一两年左右，跟我说，

sentences.en: I'll pick you up from prison.
sentences.zh: 我来监狱接你。

sentences.en: And he did that.
sentences.zh: 他也确实这么做了。

sentences.en: He picked me up.
sentences.zh: 他来接了我。

sentences.en: Did my first meal.
sentences.zh: 吃了出狱后的第一顿饭。

sentences.en: Took me down to Venice Beach.
sentences.zh: 带我去了威尼斯海滩。

sentences.en: Bring in the salty air.
sentences.zh: 迎面吹来咸湿的空气。

sentences.en: Hear the crash of the ocean.
sentences.zh: 听着海浪拍打的声音。

sentences.en: Put my feet in the water.
sentences.zh: 把双脚浸入水中。

sentences.en: It was good, man, but I felt, I felt broken.
sentences.zh: 感觉挺好的，兄弟，但我感觉，我感觉自己碎了。

sentences.en: I felt vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 我感觉自己不堪一击。

sentences.en: This is just all of our stuff to get rid of that.
sentences.zh: 这其实就是我们用来摆脱这一切的东西。

sentences.en: The graffiti.
sentences.zh: 涂鸦。

sentences.en: We think, we think this is all we need.
sentences.zh: 我们以为，我们以为这就是我们所需的全部。

sentences.en: Well, the city, you know, they, they, I hate to say they killed my kid.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这座城市，你知道，他们，他们，我真不想说他们害死了我的孩子。

sentences.en: To this day, they never apologize about that.
sentences.zh: 直到今天，他们也没有为此道歉过。

sentences.en: He went on a school field trip and, and, uh, died in a drowning incident.
sentences.zh: 他去参加学校的实地考察，然后，呃，在溺水事故中去世了。

sentences.en: They had told none of us there was going to, there was never going to be any swimming up there.
sentences.zh: 他们没有对我们任何人说过，那上面从来、从来都不会有任何游泳活动。

sentences.en: The way it happened and all the things that happened in the city,
sentences.zh: 事情发生的方式以及在这座城市里发生的所有事情，

sentences.en: the city could have helped me, and they never chose to help me.
sentences.zh: 这座城市本可以帮我，但他们从来没选择帮我。

sentences.en: They chose to desert me.
sentences.zh: 他们选择抛弃了我。

sentences.en: They've never said, we're sorry about your son.
sentences.zh: 他们从来没有说过，我们为你的儿子感到遗憾。

sentences.en: That's, I think, one reason why I stand graffiti abatement is because
sentences.zh: 我想，这也是我坚持从事清除涂鸦工作的原因之一，因为

sentences.en: I'm not able to fix my life because you can't ever control.
sentences.zh: 我无法修复我的人生，因为你永远无法掌控一切。

sentences.en: It's like trying to herd cats.
sentences.zh: 这就像赶猫上树一样。

sentences.en: You can't control.
sentences.zh: 你根本无法掌控。

sentences.en: So I can control graffiti, which makes people's lives better.
sentences.zh: 所以我可以掌控涂鸦，这能让人们的生活变得更好。

sentences.en: So for me, it's just, I spent probably a small fortune on it, but it really saves me mentally.
sentences.zh: 所以对我而言，这差不多花了我一大笔钱，但它确实在精神上拯救了我。

sentences.en: By 2015, I was working as a journalist and writing about race and identity.
sentences.zh: 到2015年时，我是一名记者，撰写关于种族和身份认同的文章。

sentences.en: One day, I received a call from a childhood friend, Nikki, telling me about the company
sentences.zh: 有一天，我接到童年好友尼基的电话，她跟我聊起了她最近

sentences.en: she had just started in Compton.
sentences.zh: 在康普顿创立的公司。

sentences.en: Nikki's company was primarily hiring undocumented workers and formerly incarcerated people to
sentences.zh: 尼基的公司主要雇佣无证工人和有服刑经历的人，让他们去

sentences.en: groups of people who live with the most stigma.
sentences.zh: 服务那些生活在最多污名化之中的群体。

sentences.en: I walked inside of the lobby and saw a framed newspaper article featuring a black man standing
sentences.zh: 我走进大厅，看到墙上挂着一个装在框里的报纸文章，上面是一个黑人男子正站在

sentences.en: in front of a graffiti wall.
sentences.zh: 一面涂鸦墙前。

sentences.en: I took a step closer and he looked really familiar.
sentences.zh: 我走近了一步，觉得他看着非常眼熟。

sentences.en: I took another step forward and noticed that the wall read S-I-G-H-T in big and bold letters.
sentences.zh: 我又往前走了一步，注意到墙上用醒目的大字写着S-I-G-H-T。

sentences.en: It was Sight.
sentences.zh: 那是赛特。

sentences.en: Oh, damn.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: That's Sight from Scare Straight.
sentences.zh: 那不是《直面深渊》里的赛特吗。

sentences.en: Do you know Sight?
sentences.zh: 你认识赛特？

sentences.en: I asked Nikki.
sentences.zh: 我问尼基。

sentences.en: Sight?
sentences.zh: 赛特？

sentences.en: She replied.
sentences.zh: 她回答道。

sentences.en: Yeah, he works here.
sentences.zh: 对啊，他就这儿上班。

sentences.en: He's actually in the back driving the forklift.
sentences.zh: 他其实就在后面开叉车呢。

sentences.en: Let's go see if he's back there.
sentences.zh: 我们去看看他在不在后面。

sentences.en: What are the odds?
sentences.zh: 这概率有多小？

sentences.en: The three of us went out to lunch that day and began reminiscing about Scare Straight
sentences.zh: 那天我们三个出去吃午饭，开始回忆起《直面深渊》

sentences.en: and graffiti.
sentences.zh: 还有涂鸦的事。

sentences.en: Something told me to ask Sight about Aloe because there weren't a lot of other black graffiti
sentences.zh: 不知什么直觉让我向赛特打听起阿洛，因为黑人涂鸦艺术家并不多，

sentences.en: artists, so what'd I have to lose?
sentences.zh: 所以问问又不会损失什么，对吧？

sentences.en: Aloe?
sentences.zh: 阿洛？

sentences.en: Sight replied.
sentences.zh: 赛特回答说。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's my boy.
sentences.zh: 对啊，那是我铁子。

sentences.en: My jaw dropped all the way to the floor.
sentences.zh: 我的下巴惊得差点掉到地上。

sentences.en: Give me his number, I said.
sentences.zh: 把他的号给我，我说。

sentences.en: I called him and nobody answered.
sentences.zh: 我给他打了电话，但没人接。

sentences.en: I went home after lunch and later that day received a phone call from an
sentences.zh: 吃完午饭我回了家，那天晚些时候接到了一个

sentences.en: unknown number.
sentences.zh: 陌生号码的来电。

sentences.en: I answered and this mysterious voice asked,
sentences.zh: 我接了电话，一个神秘的声音问，

sentences.en: Hey, is this Bezo?
sentences.zh: 嘿，是别佐吗？

sentences.en: Aloe and I met up a week later at Earth Cafe in downtown LA.
sentences.zh: 一周后，我和阿洛在洛杉矶市中心的地球咖啡馆见面了。

sentences.en: I was nervous and I was scared.
sentences.zh: 我很紧张，也很害怕。

sentences.en: Because even though a lot of time had passed, I didn't know how he felt.
sentences.zh: 因为尽管已经过了很久，我不知道他是怎么想的。

sentences.en: Maybe he felt abandoned by me.
sentences.zh: 也许他觉得被我抛弃了。

sentences.en: When I saw him, he didn't really look like Tupac anymore.
sentences.zh: 当我看到他时，他看起来已经不太像图帕克了。

sentences.en: He now had a fro and tattoo sleeves halfway down his arMs.
sentences.zh: 他现在留着爆炸头，双臂有一半都是纹身。

sentences.en: Honestly, he looked like he had been through a lot.
sentences.zh: 老实说，他看起来经历了很多沧桑。

sentences.en: But he still had that same charming smile and that same laugh.
sentences.zh: 但他依然带着那种迷人的微笑和同样的笑声。

sentences.en: So much had happened since we last saw one another.
sentences.zh: 自从我们上次见面以来，发生了太多的事。

sentences.en: He had gotten married.
sentences.zh: 他结婚了。

sentences.en: He had survived two drug overdoses.
sentences.zh: 他经历过两次药物过量并活了下来。

sentences.en: He's vegetarian.
sentences.zh: 他成了素食主义者。

sentences.en: And of all things, like of all the things in the world,
sentences.zh: 而且最不可思议的是，在世上所有的事当中，

sentences.en: he was starting to become a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 他开始当律师了。

sentences.en: A lawyer.
sentences.zh: 一个律师。

sentences.en: We talked about our families, about food, and our friends.
sentences.zh: 我们聊了各自的家庭、食物还有朋友。

sentences.en: And towards the end of the night, he looked at me and said he had something to give me.
sentences.zh: 到了深夜快结束时，他看着我，说他有东西要给我。

sentences.en: I was just like, hey, do you remember this?
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，嘿，你还记得这个吗？

sentences.en: And I remember your face was just like, wow.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时你的表情就像是，哇塞。

sentences.en: He handed me a slap tag.
sentences.zh: 他递给我一张即时贴标签。

sentences.en: Remember those post office stickers he talked about earlier?
sentences.zh: 还记得他之前提过的那些邮局贴纸吗？

sentences.en: Will I have filled this one out the same night we got arrested?
sentences.zh: 我竟然在我们被捕当晚填好过这个！

sentences.en: Before that weird Hawaiian punch craving.
sentences.zh: 就在渴望喝到诡异的夏威夷果汁之前。

sentences.en: This slap tag had our names on it.
sentences.zh: 这张标签上有我们两个人的名字。

sentences.en: It said Bezo.
sentences.zh: 上面写着别佐。

sentences.en: It said Aloe.
sentences.zh: 上面写着阿洛。

sentences.en: And it said our crews.
sentences.zh: 还写了我们的涂鸦帮派。

sentences.en: And he had kept this one slap tag.
sentences.zh: 而他竟然把这张标签保留了下来。

sentences.en: Through the years.
sentences.zh: 历经岁月。

sentences.en: Through everything.
sentences.zh: 历经一切。

sentences.en: And now I had that slap tag.
sentences.zh: 现在我拥有了那张标签。

sentences.en: And it's one of the most important things of my life.
sentences.zh: 这是我一生中最宝贵的东西之一。

sentences.en: Meeting up with Sight and Aloe prompted me to see what our old nemesis Joe was up to.
sentences.zh: 与赛特和阿洛的重逢促使我去看看我们的老冤家乔最近在忙些什么。

sentences.en: Maybe it was closure I was seeking.
sentences.zh: 也许我寻找的是一种心灵的解脱。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: So I found Joe on the internet.
sentences.zh: 于是我在网上找到了乔。

sentences.en: I contacted him.
sentences.zh: 我联系了他。

sentences.en: And I spent a few days with him.
sentences.zh: 我和他一起度过了几天。

sentences.en: How you doing, Joe?
sentences.zh: 你最近怎么样，乔？

sentences.en: I'm good, man.
sentences.zh: 我挺好的，兄弟。

sentences.en: It turns out Joe hasn't changed.
sentences.zh: 结果证明乔一点也没变。

sentences.en: He's still covering up graffiti.
sentences.zh: 他依然在覆盖涂鸦。

sentences.en: And he's still doing it for free.
sentences.zh: 而且他依然是免费在做这件事。

sentences.en: I was wrong about Joe.
sentences.zh: 我对乔的看法大错特错了。

sentences.en: This dude really surprised me.
sentences.zh: 这家伙真的让我大吃一惊。

sentences.en: He lives in South Central with his wife.
sentences.zh: 他和妻子住在中南部地区。

sentences.en: And cares for an abused pit bull.
sentences.zh: 还照顾着一只饱受虐待的比特犬。

sentences.en: Yeah, so I think she probably was in a yard where she was like a dog where there was a male slot.
sentences.zh: 对啊，所以我觉得她以前可能待在一个院子里，就像那种有一只公狗的狗舍。

sentences.en: Come on, come on, come on.
sentences.zh: 来吧，来吧，来吧。

sentences.en: I really expected Joe to greet me at the door with a red MAGA hat on.
sentences.zh: 我本来真以为乔会戴着一顶红色的MAGA帽子在门口迎接我。

sentences.en: But he didn't.
sentences.zh: 但他并没有。

sentences.en: He does have an award from Trump, though.
sentences.zh: 不过他确实拿过特朗普颁发的奖项。

sentences.en: For graffiti abatement.
sentences.zh: 为了表彰清除涂鸦的工作。

sentences.en: Of all things.
sentences.zh: 真是什么事都有。

sentences.en: President Trump.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统。

sentences.en: Best guy in the planet for community in the state of California.
sentences.zh: 全加利福尼亚州对社区最好的家伙。

sentences.en: 40 million people.
And I'm the only one who's got one of those in the state of California.
sentences.zh: 而我是在加利福尼亚州唯一一个拿到这个奖的人。

sentences.en: Anyways, Joe actually hates the government.
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，乔其实挺讨厌政府的。

sentences.en: These people don't give a **** about our people.
sentences.zh: 这帮人根本他妈的一点也不在乎我们老百姓。

sentences.en: What he means are everyday people.
sentences.zh: 他的意思是指普通人。

sentences.en: Working class folks.
sentences.zh: 工薪阶层的百姓。

sentences.en: And especially people of color.
sentences.zh: 尤其是少数族裔。

sentences.en: And Joe's also really into fitness.
sentences.zh: 而且乔也非常热衷于健身。

sentences.en: He's an avid bike rider.
sentences.zh: 他是个狂热的自行车骑手。

sentences.en: And a former football player from the south side of Chicago.
sentences.zh: 曾是来自芝加哥南区的美式橄榄球运动员。

sentences.en: Rudy, that **** guy stole my story.
sentences.zh: 鲁迪，那个混蛋家伙偷了我的故事。

sentences.en: What do you mean that?
sentences.zh: 你这话什么意思？

sentences.en: Remember the film Rudy?
sentences.zh: 还记得电影《追梦赤子心》吗？

sentences.en: The classic?
sentences.zh: 那部经典电影？

sentences.en: That **** guy stole my story.
sentences.zh: 那个混蛋家伙偷了我的故事。

sentences.en: That was my thing, man.
sentences.zh: 那是我的经历，兄弟。

sentences.en: I wanted to be a walk-on football player.
sentences.zh: 我以前就想当个非奖学金的橄榄球运动员。

sentences.en: Where?
sentences.zh: 在哪里？

sentences.en: And D.
sentences.zh: 在圣母大学。

sentences.en: And then that ****, he got there three years ahead of me and took my **** crazy.
sentences.zh: 然后那个混蛋，他比我早三年进球队，抢走了我的机会，真是太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Oh, well.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Here we are.
sentences.zh: 我们到啦。

sentences.en: Yeah, here we are.
sentences.zh: 对，我们到了。

sentences.en: I decided to bring Joe and Sight together because I wanted them to talk about how they perceive one another.
sentences.zh: 我决定把Joe和Sight聚在一起，因为我想让他们谈谈彼此是怎么看对方的。

sentences.en: Sight thinks Joe was a part of the problem.
sentences.zh: Sight觉得Joe是问题制造者之一。

sentences.en: You know, just another white dude who's part of the system to lock the black and brown people.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就像那种体制内的白人老哥，专门把黑人和棕色人种关进监狱。

sentences.en: Joe, on the other hand, had never met Sight, the human.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，Joe以前从没见过现实生活中的Sight。

sentences.en: He buffed out a lot of his pieces, but he didn't know the man.
sentences.zh: 他涂白过Sight的好多作品，但并不认识这个人。

sentences.en: He thought Sight was just another dude from the hood who got caught up in the system.
sentences.zh: 他以为Sight只是街头混混里卷进这套体制的又一个普通人。

sentences.en: So I invited both of them to my aunt's house to talk because it was a neutral space.
sentences.zh: 所以我邀请他们俩到我阿姨家聊聊，因为那里是个中立空间。

sentences.en: I wanted both of them to feel as comfortable as possible.
sentences.zh: 我希望他们两个都能感到尽可能舒适。

sentences.en: I mean, I really didn't know what was going to happen.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我真的不知道接下来会发生什么。

sentences.en: Sight's like, you know, somebody who is really chill and really mellow, but...
sentences.zh: Sight这个人吧，怎么说呢，非常随和沉稳，但是……

sentences.en: Sight!
sentences.zh: Sight！

sentences.en: Joe's kind of out there.
sentences.zh: Joe这人性格挺跳脱的。

sentences.en: How are you, man?
sentences.zh: 最近怎么样，老兄？

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 挺好的。

sentences.en: So you still putting **** on the walls?
sentences.zh: 所以你现在还在墙上乱涂乱画吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对啊。

sentences.en: Are you really?
sentences.zh: 真的假的？

sentences.en: That's good.
sentences.zh: 那挺好的。

sentences.en: I like that.
sentences.zh: 我挺喜欢那样。

sentences.en: They sat at my aunt's dining table and talked about what they agreed on.
sentences.zh: 他们坐在我阿姨家的餐桌旁，聊着彼此意见一致的事情。

sentences.en: Graffiti, when you're looking at the outside of it, it's ugly.
sentences.zh: 从外表来看，涂鸦是很难看的。

sentences.en: It's horrible.
sentences.zh: 简直糟糕透顶。

sentences.en: It's this and that.
sentences.zh: 各种不堪入目。

sentences.en: But once you step foot into that world, it's a whole other perspective on the matter.
sentences.zh: 但一旦你踏入那个世界，就会对这件事产生完全不同的看法。

sentences.en: You'll never be able to relate unless you hang out with graffiti artists or are graffiti artists.
sentences.zh: 除非你经常和涂鸦艺术家混在一起，或者你本身就是涂鸦艺术家，否则你永远无法感同身受。

sentences.en: You'll never be able to relate.
sentences.zh: 你永远无法真正理解。

sentences.en: It'll just be judging from the outside in.
sentences.zh: 那只会是隔靴搔痒的评判。

sentences.en: And Sight wasn't messing around.
sentences.zh: 而且Sight可不是在开玩笑。

sentences.en: He came ready.
sentences.zh: 他是带着准备来的。

sentences.en: He even reached out to the graffiti community on Facebook to see if they had any questions for Joe.
sentences.zh: 他甚至在Facebook的涂鸦社群里发帖，看看大家有没有什么问题想问Joe。

sentences.en: Do you want to hear those questions?
sentences.zh: 你想听听这些问题吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, let's go.
sentences.zh: 好啊，来吧。

sentences.en: Shy and Blanks want to know why you buffed out the rooftop in 92 and told them to get day jobs.
sentences.zh: Shy和Blanks想知道，你为什么在92年涂掉了那处屋顶，还叫他们去找份正经工作。

sentences.en: I thought it was just funny.
sentences.zh: 我当时就觉得挺搞笑的。

sentences.en: It was just funny.
sentences.zh: 纯粹觉得好玩。

sentences.en: It came from an American Express commercial.
sentences.zh: 灵感是来自一个美国运通的广告。

sentences.en: Another person asks, why did you...
sentences.zh: 另一个人问，你为什么……

sentences.en: Some of the questions were really angry.
sentences.zh: 有些问题火药味真的很浓。

sentences.en: That's Caltrans.
sentences.zh: 那是加州交通局。

sentences.en: Caltrans is so insane about how they buffed Berners.
sentences.zh: 加州交通局对清理伯纳斯的涂鸦简直丧心病狂。

sentences.en: Sight told Joe he was really hated.
sentences.zh: Sight告诉Joe，他其实很招人恨。

sentences.en: A lot of people plotted on you.
sentences.zh: 很多人都在算计你。

sentences.en: They plotted on your family.
sentences.zh: 他们在算计你的家人。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: A lot of people went after your kids secretly.
sentences.zh: 很多人暗地里对你的孩子下手。

sentences.en: I can't say who.
sentences.zh: 我不能说是谁。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: And it's almost similar to like...
sentences.zh: 这就有点类似于……

sentences.en: I don't want to say it.
sentences.zh: 我不想说下去了。

sentences.en: I don't want to be disrespectful.
sentences.zh: 我不想表现得不尊重。

sentences.en: But like, you know how a cop goes out and shoots a kid or arrests kids and people feel that pain forever?
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道就像警察开枪打死小孩或者逮捕小孩，然后人们那种痛苦会持续一辈子吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It's kind of like the same.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像是一样的。

sentences.en: It seemed like the news that people went after Joe's kids really affected him.
sentences.zh: 人们对Joe的孩子下手的消息，似乎对Joe产生了很大的打击。

sentences.en: Especially since Joe had lost his son.
sentences.zh: 尤其是Joe刚刚失去了自己的儿子。

sentences.en: He was physically shaken.
sentences.zh: 他整个人都在颤抖。

sentences.en: And he really let down his guard.
sentences.zh: 他也真的卸下了防备。

sentences.en: Joe revealed a different side to him that people weren't used to seeing.
sentences.zh: Joe展现出了他平时不为人知的一面。

sentences.en: It didn't feel like a performance anymore.
sentences.zh: 那感觉不再像是在演戏。

sentences.en: It felt like we were finally getting the real Joe.
sentences.zh: 感觉我们终于见到了真实卸下伪装的Joe。

sentences.en: After I lost my son, I lost my grandmother, my parents, my brothers, my in-laws, my sister-in-laws,
sentences.zh: 在我失去儿子之后，我又失去了祖母、父母、兄弟、岳父母、小姨子……

sentences.en: a lot of artists, a lot of people I knew, a lot of people in my community.
sentences.zh: 还有许多艺术家，我认识的很多人，社区里的许多人。

sentences.en: I mean, there was a time in like 99 through 07, 08, where there's a lot of funerals.
sentences.zh: 我是说，在99年到07、08年那段时间，有好多葬礼。

sentences.en: There's just so many funerals.
sentences.zh: 有办不完的葬礼。

sentences.en: And it just, I mean, it's a lot.
sentences.zh: 而且，我的意思是，真的经历太多了。

sentences.en: And so I just, and then with a lot of things, mainly with my son, and there's still fall off from that,
sentences.zh: 所以我就……再加上经历了很多事，主要是关于我儿子的事，直到现在余波未平，

sentences.en: which is now almost, it's almost 21 years.
sentences.zh: 算起来现在都已经快，快21年了。

sentences.en: You know, and so I just kind of then just really became a liar.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，所以后来我基本上就变成了一个满口谎言的人。

sentences.en: I don't mean to cut you off.
sentences.zh: 我不是故意打断你。

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 没事，没事，没事。

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 没事。

sentences.en: You know, I've met a lot of different graffiti artists.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我见过很多不同的涂鸦艺术家。

sentences.en: At least about 1,000 of them that I know or more have the same story as you, are similar.
sentences.zh: 我认识或了解的至少有一千人左右，他们的经历和你一样，或者非常相似。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And I'm listening to you.
sentences.zh: 我在听你讲。

sentences.en: I'm listening to you.
sentences.zh: 我在听着呢。

sentences.en: And what people don't know and people forget is any kind of painting is therapeutic.
sentences.zh: 人们不知道也常常忘记的是，任何形式的绘画都有治疗作用。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Painting, doing art activates one side of the brain that helps heal trauma.
sentences.zh: 画画、搞艺术能够激活大脑的一侧，有助于治愈心灵创伤。

sentences.en: You know, you've been through some trauma.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你也经历过一些创伤。

sentences.en: I feel that the more, the longer that person paints reflects how much healing they need
sentences.zh: 我觉得一个人画画的时间越长、次数越多，就反映出他需要多少疗愈，

sentences.en: and how much therapy that painting provides.
sentences.zh: 以及绘画提供了多少心理治疗。

sentences.en: I still do it because I still suffer through trauma.
sentences.zh: 我到现在还在画，因为我依然在经受创伤的折磨。

sentences.en: That has not been rooted yet, uprooted.
sentences.zh: 那些创伤还没有被彻底拔除。

sentences.en: So, and I see it in you.
sentences.zh: 所以，我在你身上也看到了这一点。

sentences.en: You might not be doing graffiti, but you are painting over it.
sentences.zh: 你可能不再搞涂鸦了，但你依然在用别的方式去覆盖它。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: Yet it is still, in a way, therapeutic and provides a sense of relief.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，这依然具有治疗作用，能带来一种解脱感。

sentences.en: And the other side of that is that it's fun.
sentences.zh: 而另一方面，这也是一件很有趣的事。

sentences.en: It's competitive.
sentences.zh: 它很有竞争性。

sentences.en: And there's some people that are game, and so believe we're not.
sentences.zh: 信不信由你，有些人就是喜欢这种游戏。

sentences.en: In that moment, I think Joe finally felt seen in her, too.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，我觉得Joe在她的身上也终于找到了被看见的感觉。

sentences.en: He wasn't the in-your-face Joe, the wild Joe, the rah-rah-rah Joe, you know?
sentences.zh: 他不再是那个咄咄逼人的Joe，那个疯狂的Joe，那个情绪高亢的Joe，你懂吗？

sentences.en: He was soft, and he was gentle.
sentences.zh: 他变得很温和，很柔软。

sentences.en: In sight, I'm pretty sure he felt the same way, too.
sentences.zh: 我敢肯定，Sight当时也有同感。

sentences.en: People see walls with graffiti on them and think that the people responsible for the tags are criminals.
sentences.zh: 人们看到写满涂鸦的墙壁，就会觉得留下标签的人是罪犯。

sentences.en: But it's hard to know that there's a whole life behind the spray paint that emerges on the wall.
sentences.zh: 但很难想象，那些喷漆背后其实是一个个鲜活的人生。

sentences.en: And to be real, it's impossible to see the things that people are dealing with at home.
sentences.zh: 说实话，你根本无从得知这些人回到家里正在面对什么。

sentences.en: It's already hard enough being a teenager.
sentences.zh: 当个青少年本就已经够难了。

sentences.en: But imagine not having a way to express yourself.
sentences.zh: 但想象一下，连一个表达自我的途径都没有，那该有多难。

sentences.en: That's really hard.
sentences.zh: 那真的很不容易。

sentences.en: Some see it as property damage.
sentences.zh: 有些人认为这是破坏财产。

sentences.en: But what about the damage people are experiencing in their own lives?
sentences.zh: 但人们在自己的生活中遭受的创伤又该怎么算呢？

sentences.en: Each piece of graffiti is a window into someone's life.
sentences.zh: 每一幅涂鸦都是通往一个人内心的窗户。

sentences.en: Sometimes, though, the window is hard to see through because there's writing on it.
sentences.zh: 不过有时，这扇窗很难看透，因为上面写满了字。

sentences.en: But each window and each wall tells a different story.
sentences.zh: 但每一扇窗、每一面墙都在诉说着不同的故事。

sentences.en: The walls are the first thing I see when I travel to a new place.
sentences.zh: 每当我到一个新地方，墙壁总是我看到的第一样东西。

sentences.en: They tell me everything I need to know about where I'm at.
sentences.zh: 它们告诉我所有关于我所处环境的信息。

sentences.en: They alert me of danger, tell me who lives in that community, and who I need to be aware of.
sentences.zh: 它们提醒我注意危险，告诉我这个社区住着什么人，我需要防范谁。

sentences.en: Let's go back to that bus.
sentences.zh: 让我们回到那辆公交车上。

sentences.en: Spring 2017.
I'm on the 733 bus line, and we're heading west on Venice Boulevard.
sentences.zh: 我正坐着733路公交车，往威尼斯大道的西方向开去。

sentences.en: I'm sitting in the back of the bus.
sentences.zh: 我坐在车厢最后面。

sentences.en: It's the early afternoon, and there's nobody else sitting next to me.
sentences.zh: 那是刚过正午的时候，我旁边没有坐别人。

sentences.en: I'm listening to music on my headphones when I notice an old friend hop on.
sentences.zh: 我正戴着耳机听音乐，突然注意到一个老朋友上了车。

sentences.en: It's Ivan, and we used to be in the same circles when I used to tag.
sentences.zh: 是伊凡，我以前到处留名时，我们曾在同一个圈子里。

sentences.en: Ivan hasn't changed one bit.
sentences.zh: 伊凡一点都没变。

sentences.en: He's still wearing oversized t-shirts and still speaks from the side of his mouth like he used to.
sentences.zh: 他还是穿着超大号T恤，说话时依然习惯像以前那样斜着嘴。

sentences.en: And his hair is still cut really low.
sentences.zh: 头发也依然剪得很短。

sentences.en: It's been more than 15 years since we last saw one another.
sentences.zh: 我们上次见面已经过去十五年多了。

sentences.en: We dab each other up and hug, and he sits right next to me.
sentences.zh: 我们击拳拥抱，他就在我旁边坐了下来。

sentences.en: Hey, you still write?
sentences.zh: 嘿，你还在写吗？

sentences.en: When Ivan asked me if I still wrote, I paused.
sentences.zh: 当伊凡问我是否还在涂鸦时，我停顿了一下。

sentences.en: Because the truth is, nothing's really changed.
sentences.zh: 因为事实是，一切都没怎么变。

sentences.en: I am still writing.
sentences.zh: 我其实还在创作。

sentences.en: I'm just not writing on walls or buses or freeways anymore.
sentences.zh: 只是不再在墙壁、公交车或高速公路上写了。

sentences.en: But I'm still writing to be seen.
sentences.zh: 但我依然在通过文字来渴望被看见。

sentences.en: Yeah, I told Ivan.
sentences.zh: 对，我告诉伊凡。

sentences.en: I do still write.
sentences.zh: 我确实还在写。
